_comment: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA — ChronoGraph AI. This document is SYNTHETIC and for demonstration only.

tickets.title: Implement GitHub OAuth as second OAuth provider
tickets.description: Following the success of Google OAuth, this ticket tracks the proposal to add GitHub OAuth as a second sign-in option, primarily targeting developer users.
tickets.notes: Awaiting product approval. No implementation has begun.

tickets.title: Remove legacy password reset email template v1
tickets.description: The old password reset email template (template_v1.html) was removed and replaced with template_v2.html which uses the new branding guidelines.
tickets.notes: This is a modification to the Password Authentication feature, not a removal of the feature itself.

tickets.title: Database migration: add google_id column
tickets.description: Database migration script to add google_id (VARCHAR 255, nullable) and auth_provider (ENUM) columns to the users table. Executed as part of PR-247 deployment.

tickets.title: Rename Authentication Module to Identity and Access Module
tickets.description: The Authentication Module is being renamed to Identity and Access Module to reflect expanded scope including authorization (RBAC) features planned for Q1 2025.
tickets.notes: Rename decision was made in the October 15 team meeting.

tickets.title: REJECTED: Remove password authentication immediately
tickets.description: An informal proposal to remove password authentication immediately (rather than through a phased deprecation) was reviewed and rejected. The team decided a phased approach is necessary.
tickets.reason: Immediate removal poses risk to enterprise customers and accessibility. Phased deprecation proposal AUTH-DEPR-01 remains active.
